destructive_actions: applying generated output directly over a hand-authored source plugin
human_checks: semantic conflict policy encoded by a custom patcher

coverage.description: Load-order-derived patcher pipeline. Current source exposes CLI run-patcher support and 0.36.6 includes split-mod improvements.
known_gaps: third-party patchers can contain arbitrary logic and must be pinned/reviewed
successful patcher execution does not prove semantic compatibility
very large master sets require split-output validation
coverage.denominator_probe: configured patchers vs executed patchers; source plugins discovered vs processed; output masters vs expected

requires_confirmation_for: using an unreviewed third-party patcher in a release build
safety.sandbox_or_scope: Run against dedicated test profile/load-order snapshot and isolated output path.

verification.output_readback: Reload every generated split/output plugin and validate master closure.

ai.context_cost_notes: Use when output must depend on the consumer load order; do not use merely because a static plugin could be generated.

evidence.notes: Latest release observed: 0.36.6; current source exposes run-patcher CLI with OutputPath/GameRelease and split-output parameters.
